name: inset-lobe-vanishes
why: A 20 x 5 bar with a 3 mm stem, inset by 2: the stem is narrower than twice the wall, so the offset removes the loop its sides fold into and what is left is the bar's inset, 16 x 1 by closed form, 80 mm3 at 5 tall. The vertex the removed loop leaves splits the 16 mm edge in two, hence 7 faces. A fold left behind would come nearer than 2 mm to the outline and be refused as short, with where.
